items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Delton Russo, he's still playing. That's the guys that I remember out of the band that got to be something later on.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had, we must have had, well I said 30 some pieces. And out of the whole band, there's about five of us that still play. But Wardell Cazare is one. Yeah, Wardell Cazare. He played trumpet. Delton Russo, he's still playing. That's the guys that I remember out of the band that got to be something later on. Tyler and myself, that's all. But Clyde Carr was a, he was a musician's musician. Everything we played with him was written. Everything. He didn't play anything that wasn't written out. He never played…
On the bandstand. Did he put you in the studio?
